goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T009 plus T011 close every T004 rejection. Handle-ineligible primaries now receive an editor-only fallback marker with visible styling, and both snapshot and clean serialization remove it. Active marquee and precise-pointer Escape handling precedes focus/modal guards, while cancellation arms successor-click suppression. Main now delegates gesture classification and state transitions to the behaviorally tested StageGestureController. Focused-control, modal, drag-suppression, lock, serialization, threshold, pan, commit, and cancellation tests are substantive. Fresh typecheck, 164 targeted tests, and production build pass. T005 browser QA may begin.

evidence.proof: SvgEditor computes canInstallHandles and applies data-lineage-primary-fallback when locked, agent-blocked, hidden-by-attribute, or resource-heavy selections cannot receive svg.js handles. Blue fallback styles are distinct from purple secondary feedback. Behavioral tests cover locked and complex-resource primaries while confirming ordinary unlocked handles return.
serializeSvg removes data-lineage-primary-fallback and data-lineage-secondary before both clean exports and snapshots. Tests assert exact clean markup and absence under stripEditorState false.
Active marquee or precise-pointer Escape is handled before dialog and editable-target early returns. Connected, focused inspector controls and an open dialog are exercised behaviorally.

cancelMarquee and cancelPrecisePointer arm the shared 250ms canvas-click suppression window before releasing capture. Immediate successor clicks after Escape and pointercancel are proven unable to clear or toggle restored selection.

Main uses StageGestureController as the source of pan/marquee state transitions. Tests execute middle and Space pan precedence, object and modified-pointer exclusion, 3px pending, 4px activation, additive below-threshold commit semantics, pointerup commit, pointercancel, lost-capture cancellation, and stale-pointer rejection. Editor tests separately prove Shift below-threshold no-op and unmodified clear.

Capture-phase exact-pointer handling stops immediate propagation. A simulated object pointerdown listener receives zero events, while moved precise sequences preserve SVG bytes, selection, and history.
